body:
## Pull request overview

Adds end-user documentation and runnable examples for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, plus new “Hub Protocol” reference pages in the docs site.

**Changes:**
- Added a comprehensive authentication guide and linked it into the Guides navigation.
- Added a new `examples/minimal-auth/` reference project (server + auth flow script) and listed it in the examples catalog.
- Added Hub Protocol reference pages under `content/docs/references/hub/`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 16 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated 23 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds workspace importer entries for the new `examples/minimal-auth` package. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/examples/basic-usage.ts | Updates example to new kernel lifecycle (`use()` + `bootstrap()` + `shutdown()`). |
| examples/minimal-auth/package.json | New minimal-auth example package with workspace deps and `dev/test` scripts. |
| examples/minimal-auth/tsconfig.json | TypeScript config for the new example package. |
| examples/minimal-auth/src/server.ts | Minimal server showing ObjectQL + Hono server + AuthPlugin wiring. |
| examples/minimal-auth/src/test-auth.ts | Script intended to test register → logout → login → session flow. |
| examples/minimal-auth/README.md | Quickstart + usage notes for the minimal-auth example. |
| examples/README.md | Adds “Minimal Auth” to the examples catalog. |
| content/docs/guides/meta.json | Adds “authentication” to Guides navigation. |
| content/docs/guides/authentication.mdx | New authentication guide with setup, endpoints, and client examples. |
| content/docs/references/hub/meta.json | Adds a new “Hub Protocol” docs section and page list. |
| content/docs/references/hub/license.mdx | New reference page for “License” protocol. |
| content/docs/references/hub/plugin-registry.mdx | New reference page for “Plugin Registry” protocol. |
| content/docs/references/hub/plugin-security.mdx | New reference page for “Plugin Security” protocol. |
| content/docs/references/hub/registry-config.mdx | New reference page for “Registry Config” protocol. |
| content/docs/references/hub/tenant.mdx | New reference page for “Tenant” protocol. |
| PLUGIN_AUTH_COMPLETION.md | Adds a completion/status summary for plugin-auth deliverables. |
</details>

<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

</details>

<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**packages/plugins/plugin-auth/examples/basic-usage.ts:31**
* `databaseUrl` is passed in options, but the current `AuthManager` implementation ignores it and only uses `dataEngine` (ObjectQL adapter) for persistence. Keeping this here implies it has an effect when it doesn't; either remove it from the example or document that ObjectQL is the persistence layer and `databaseUrl` is not used.
```
      secret: process.env.AUTH_SECRET || 'your-secret-key-at-least-32-chars',
      baseUrl: process.env.BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000',
      databaseUrl: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
      
```
</details>

The TypeScript usage snippet imports the same symbols as both values and types, which is invalid (duplicate identifiers). Additionally, `@objectstack/spec/hub` is deprecated for these protocols; prefer `@objectstack/spec/kernel` for plugin security schemas.

The callout source path is incorrect (no `packages/spec/src/hub/plugin-registry.zod.ts`). These schemas are under `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-registry.zod.ts` and re-exported by `packages/spec/src/hub/index.ts`. Update the Source reference to the actual file path.
```suggestion
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-registry.zod.ts`
```

The TypeScript usage snippet imports the same names as both values and types, which is invalid in TS. Also, since `@objectstack/spec/hub` is marked deprecated, the docs should prefer `@objectstack/spec/system` for the license schemas.

This example hard-codes a fallback `secret` string. Since `AuthPlugin` throws if `secret` is missing, the safest pattern is to require `AUTH_SECRET` (and fail fast with a clear message) or generate a per-run dev secret. A fixed string is easy to accidentally ship to production and weakens session/token security.

The callout source path is incorrect (no `packages/spec/src/hub/plugin-security.zod.ts`). These schemas live under `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-security*.zod.ts` and are re-exported by `packages/spec/src/hub/index.ts`. Please update the Source reference accordingly.
```suggestion
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/hub/index.ts` (re-exports `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-security*.zod.ts`)
```

This section suggests persistence "automatically" works with an existing ObjectQL setup, but `AuthPlugin` currently hard-requires the `data` service (`ctx.getService('data')`) during init and will fail to bootstrap if it's missing. Please clarify that applications must register an ObjectQL/IDataEngine as the `data` service (or change the plugin to handle missing `data` gracefully) so readers don't end up with a non-working setup.
```suggestion
The plugin automatically uses your application's `data` service (typically an ObjectQL/IDataEngine instance) for persistence. As long as you have registered a `data` service in your `ObjectKernel` configuration, no additional database configuration is required for auth — it will reuse your existing ObjectQL setup.
```

The example registers an ObjectQL driver but never calls `objectql.init()`, so drivers won’t get a chance to `connect()` (it happens in `ObjectQL.init()`). It works for the in-memory driver because connect is a no-op, but the example will be misleading for real drivers; consider calling `await objectql.init()` during startup (and `await objectql.destroy()` on shutdown).

This script uses `ObjectStackClient` auth methods (`register/login/logout/me`), but the client currently calls `/api/v1/auth/register|login|logout|me` while `AuthPlugin` exposes better-auth endpoints under `/api/v1/auth/sign-up/email`, `/sign-in/email`, etc. As a result, this "complete auth flow" test won’t work against the minimal-auth server as written. Update the script to call the better-auth endpoints (or update the client implementation) so the example is actually runnable.

The TypeScript usage snippet uses both value and type imports for the same names, which will cause duplicate identifier errors in TS. Also consider switching imports away from the deprecated `@objectstack/spec/hub` entrypoint to `@objectstack/spec/system` (per `packages/spec/src/hub/index.ts`).

The callout source path is incorrect (no `packages/spec/src/hub/license.zod.ts`). License schemas live under `packages/spec/src/system/license.zod.ts` and are re-exported by `packages/spec/src/hub/index.ts`. Please point the docs to the real source file.
```suggestion
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/system/license.zod.ts`
```

This PR adds a new "Hub Protocol" reference section (meta.json + multiple MDX pages), but the PR description focuses on authentication docs/examples. If these hub reference pages are intentional, please update the PR description to mention them; otherwise consider moving them to a separate PR to keep scope clear.

"All 11 tests passing (100% coverage)" is not a valid inference—passing tests doesn’t imply coverage, and this repo doesn’t appear to run coverage reporting for plugin-auth. Please either remove the coverage claim or back it with an actual coverage report/metric.
```suggestion
- ✅ All 11 tests passing
```

This claims client integration is verified via `@objectstack/client`, but the current client auth methods call `/api/v1/auth/register|login|logout|me`, which doesn’t match the better-auth routes exposed by `AuthPlugin` (`/sign-up/email`, `/sign-in/email`, etc.). Unless the server provides compatibility routes, this section is misleading and should be corrected to reflect the current compatibility status.

`AuthPlugin` requires a `data` service (it calls `ctx.getService('data')` in init), but this example never registers one. As written, `kernel.bootstrap()` will fail with "[Kernel] Service 'data' not found". Register an ObjectQL/IDataEngine service (e.g., `kernel.registerService('data', objectql)` or include `ObjectQLPlugin` + a driver) before loading `AuthPlugin`.

The TypeScript usage snippet imports the same identifiers as both value and type (`import { X } ...` and `import type { X } ...`), which won’t compile (duplicate identifiers). Also, these schemas/types are deprecated under `@objectstack/spec/hub`; prefer importing runtime schemas from `@objectstack/spec/system` or `@objectstack/spec/kernel` as indicated by `packages/spec/src/hub/index.ts`.

This statement is inaccurate: `better-auth` is a direct dependency of `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (not a peer dependency), and package managers won’t "auto-install" peer deps reliably anyway. Please adjust the wording to match the package.json reality.
```suggestion
`better-auth` is included as a direct dependency of `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, so you don't need to install it separately.
```

This note is misleading: the example works without `AUTH_SECRET` only because `server.ts` hard-codes a fallback secret. The `AuthPlugin` itself currently throws if `secret` is missing, so there is no automatic dev-secret fallback at the plugin layer. Please reword to reflect what actually happens and keep the guidance production-safe.
```suggestion
> **Note**: In this example, `server.ts` falls back to a hard-coded development secret if `AUTH_SECRET` is not set. The `AuthPlugin` itself still requires a `secret` value and will throw if one is not provided, so in real applications (especially in production) you must always configure a strong, unique `AUTH_SECRET` via environment variables.
```

Re-running this test will likely fail because it always registers the same email (`test@example.com`) and many auth systems reject duplicate sign-ups. Consider generating a unique email per run (timestamp/UUID) or handling the "already exists" error by falling back to login.

The callout source path doesn’t exist (`packages/spec/src/hub/tenant.zod.ts` is not in the repo). The hub protocols are re-exported from `packages/spec/src/system/*.zod.ts` and `packages/spec/src/kernel/*.zod.ts` (see `packages/spec/src/hub/index.ts`). Please update the Source reference to the actual file location so readers can navigate to real schemas.
```suggestion
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/system/tenant.zod.ts`
```

The callout source path appears incorrect (these hub schemas are re-exported from `packages/spec/src/system/*` / `packages/spec/src/kernel/*`, and `packages/spec/src/hub/*.zod.ts` files don’t exist). Update the Source reference to the real schema file so the docs don’t point to a dead path.
```suggestion
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/system/registry-config.zod.ts`
```
